The image contains the Chimera userland and desktop on a Debian Linux kernel. It is not a native Koronos release and does not satisfy the separate native userspace handoff gate. The gallery's named Koronos Workbench preview is a browser concept, not evidence of a Koronos boot.

Release assets include the ISO, SHA-256 file, and `ISO-BOOT-REPORT.txt`.
